(ns knoxx164.owning-receipt-fulltip
  (:require [eta-mu.receipt-river.api :as api]
            [clojure.string :as str]
            ["node:fs" :as fs]
            ["node:child_process" :as cp]))
(def argv (vec *command-line-args*))
(assert (= 2 (count argv)) "Arguments: absolute worktree and full Git revision or WORKTREE")
(def root (first argv))
(def at (second argv))
(assert (.startsWith root "/"))
(assert (or (= at "WORKTREE") (re-matches #"[0-9a-f]{40}" at)))
(def text (if (= at "WORKTREE")
            (.readFileSync fs (str root "/.ημ/receipts.edn") "utf8")
            (.execFileSync cp "git" #js ["-C" root "show" (str at ":.ημ/receipts.edn")] #js {:encoding "utf8"})))
(def lines (vec (str/split-lines text)))
(def results (mapv (fn [i line]
                     (select-keys (api/validate-line line (inc i)) [:ok :line-number :source/schema :errors]))
                   (range (count lines)) lines))
(def owned (subvec results 16))
(assert (seq owned))
(assert (every? #(and (:ok %) (= :declared (get-in % [:source/schema :status]))) owned))
(println (pr-str {:at at :scope :all-physical-lines :total (count results)
                 :inherited-refused (mapv :line-number (filter (complement :ok) (subvec results 0 16)))
                 :owned-results owned :all-history-valid (every? :ok results)}))
